segments.sn35.52:1.3: Cakkhu, bhikkhave, upassaṭṭhaṃ, rūpā upassaṭṭhā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ upassaṭṭhaṃ, cakkhusamphasso upassaṭṭho.
segments.sn35.52:1.4: Yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi upassaṭṭhaṃ … pe … jivhā upassaṭṭhā, rasā upassaṭṭhā, jivhāviññāṇaṃ upassaṭṭhaṃ, jivhāsamphasso upassaṭṭho.
segments.sn35.52:1.6: Yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi upassaṭṭhaṃ.
segments.sn35.52:1.7: Kāyo upassaṭṭho … mano upassaṭṭho, dhammā upassaṭṭhā, manoviññāṇaṃ upassaṭṭhaṃ, manosamphasso upassaṭṭho.
segments.sn35.52:1.9: Yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi upassaṭṭhaṃ.
segments.sn35.52:1.10: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, rūpesupi nibbindati, cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati, cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.52:1.11: Yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati … pe … manasmimpi nibbindati, dhammesupi nibbindati, manoviññāṇepi nibbindati, manosamphassepi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.52:1.13: Yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.52:1.14: Nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati; vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
segments.sn35.52:1.15: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.
segments.sn35.52:2.3: Pahātabbaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ, abhiññeyyapariññeyyaṃ [abhiññeyyaṃ pariññeyyaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ.), abhiññātaṃ pariññeyyaṃ (pī. ka.)];
